description: Topics: essay-editor, personas, reader, view-link, citations, agent-interrogation. The owner named the reader as the next persona: someone sent an essay who wants the finished read-only piece, without the comments it was built on, with links, sources and citations available, and an agent as an optional way to interrogate it further. Domain and personas come first; how to address it follows.
title: 2026-11-04 · The reader of a shared essay
